name: Vinarosa Resort & Spa
positioning: Vineyard resort and spa in Santa Rosa, at the center of the Russian River Valley and greater Sonoma County
best_for: Travelers who want a vineyard setting with a spa in Sonoma County
Guests looking for a base in the Russian River Valley

facts.text: The resort is located in Santa Rosa, at the center of the Russian River Valley and greater Sonoma County.
Rooms and suites are set within intimate two-story buildings.
Rooms look out over the vineyard or over garden courtyards with flowers and fountains.
First-floor rooms open to furnished patios.
The Vinarosa Suite is a one-bedroom suite that opens to a large terrace with comfortable seating.
The Lavender Suite sits on a corner closer to the vineyard for added quiet and privacy.
Each room has a refrigerator stocked with water, soft drinks and a half bottle of wine.
Guests can explore the grounds on guided vineyard walks.
The spa's relaxation lounge has a stone fireplace and sheer drapery dividers.
The spa's men's and women's changing rooms have eucalyptus steam rooms.
The Vinarosa Signature Facial uses EmerginC Scientific Organics products powered by grape stem cells.
John Ash is one of Sonoma's original farm-to-table restaurants.

highlights.text: Vineyard trails let guests explore the resort's 92 vineyard acres.
The outdoor pool has vineyard views and private cabanas.
The spa has an indoor caldarium with a warm plunge bath.
Second-floor rooms include furnished balconies and vaulted wood-beamed ceilings.
The Vineyard Wine Salt Scrub is a body polish made from mineral-rich sea salts and locally grown wine.

considerations.text: Rooms face either the vineyard or the garden courtyards, so a vineyard view depends on the room chosen.
WhataHotel notes the secluded Wine Country location may require a car for nearby excursions.
WhataHotel notes premium resort pricing reflecting the upscale Sonoma County market.
